validation_provenance.method: Independently derived prose behavior, fact statuses, all dimensions, ordered completeness overrides and composite; compared supplied references only after derivation; checked structural source/citation mappings and semantic control coverage. No evaluator execution.
validation_provenance.isolation_limitations: Procedural isolation in shared workspace. Only the four authorized input files were inspected. No evaluator code, prompts, prior suites/results, external services, API calls, Git commands or repository imports. Freeze custody is accepted from the supplied record and parent statement, not independently established by Git. Agent review, not human adjudication or expert validation.
